name: Carroll
schedule: First Tuesday when scheduled (next: April 6, 2027), Carroll County Courthouse, Carrollton
note: After each sale the county reposts its legal ad marked SOLD FOR or NO BID, so results are available for several sales.

auction.time: First Tuesday of months with a scheduled sale, legal hours 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, continuing Wednesday if necessary
auction.registration: Register online at gtsweb.com/contact-4 and select Carroll County (online registration closes at 2:00 pm the Monday before the sale). Bidders are required to bring cash, certified funds or a bank letter to the sale.
auction.payment: Cash, money order or certified check. The time to remit payment is set on the day of the sale.
vital: Buyer beware: no guarantees, expressed or implied; see the property first.
Opening bid includes all applicable taxes, penalties and costs; no-bid parcels may be re-offered after the regular sale.
The buyer may not take possession or trespass for twelve months; after that the right of redemption can be barred.
The Sheriff's Tax Deed is not a fee simple deed; it is recorded after the sale and mailed to the address given at purchase.
The purchaser pays for title, transfer costs, taxes, advertising and recording fees.
The posted sale list is reissued with updates before the sale (the April 2026 list was updated on 03/20, 03/27 and 04/03/2026).
auction.confirmed: Next sale April 6, 2027 posted; excess funds list dated September 2026
